verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a self-hosted Git service, so the axis applies. The pack only offers a general claim that self-hosting gives 'full control', plus security features like permissions, ACLs and audit logs; none of these document retention policies, data purging, or deletion controls. No first-party or community evidence shows Gitea's own capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
